actions.expect: When generating a project-local verification skill.. Creates features/README.md plus one file per identified user-facing feature (top 3-5 to start) following references/feature-map-example/ shape. Each feature file answers what the feature is, how to reach it, how to drive it with the harness, and what observable end state proves it, using the four H2s Sub-features, How to get to it (user POV), Driving it with <harness>, and Gotchas.
